items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a member of the Wilberforce Collegians named Richard Christmas, who was also a Cincinnatian.

ctx.x: Wilberforce experience and particularly the Collegians and what doors got opened for you.

I’ll have to begin with how I got into Wilberforce, because it was already the beginning of the school year. The school year had progressed at least two or three weeks. I didn’t get into Oberlin, didn’t get into the Cincinnati Conservatory, and I was just floundering out there. So my mother said, “I’d like you to go to Wilberforce if possible.” There was a member of the Wilberforce Collegians named Richard Christmas, who was also a Cincinnatian. He said, “Come on up there.
